responsibility: This header defines pointer_mux, a tiny tagged-pointer utility for representing one of two pointer types in a single machine pointer by stealing the low bit. It provides construction, tag tests, typed extraction, and dyn_cast/is_a style helpers while relying on alignment and nonnull constraints for the second alternative. Its role is a compact host-side data-structure primitive for GCC internals that need a lightweight two-way pointer union with no extra storage.
